cell: Al matrix + Fe4Al13 ridge inclusion, NO dislocations, NO solutes, 66698 atoms
method: CG minimization only (no thermal noise, no dynamics); per-atom virial averaged as a TENSOR per 4 A bin, invariant formed after averaging
verdict: At eps = 1940 ppm (19-97x the largest measured Fe-Al magnetostriction) the interface stress increment is only 19.5 MPa in von Mises and 6.6 MPa in shear, decaying to the +-2 MPa noise floor within 60 A. Rescaled to a defensible lambda_s = 40 ppm this is 0.40 MPa. The two-scale bridge requires 9-41 MPa to explain the +25% creep, so the magnetostrictive channel falls short by a factor of 20-100.
